items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I heard he played saxophone mostly down here... He was bashful. He didn't do much playing.

ctx.x: I heard he played saxophone mostly down here, I guess, did he? Yeah, he was bashful. He didn't do much playing. He took like Albert Dominic. Oh, yeah. That's my voice good cousin too.
When they call Don Albert now. Don Albert trumpet bell. Yeah, yeah. That's my question.
I know Nanny Dominic very well in Chicago. Yeah, Nanny Dominic. I must see, is his brother still living, I guess, Ferdinand Dominic?
